Fixed the __repr__ inheritance issue in DataObjectBase subclasses by preventing the @dataclass decorator from generating a conflicting __repr__ method.

Root Cause: The @dataobject decorator internally uses @dataclasses.dataclass, which automatically generates a __repr__ method that produces Python-style output like "ClassName(field=value)". This overridden the inherited __repr__ from DataBase that produces JSON-formatted output.

Fix: Modified caikit/core/data_model/dataobject.py line ~195 to call dataclasses.dataclass(cls, repr=False) instead of dataclasses.dataclass(cls). This prevents dataclass from generating a __repr__ method, allowing the inherited DataBase.__repr__ to be used properly.

Verification: 
- The specific failing test test_dataobject_repr_data_base now passes
- All tests in the specified scope pass (201 passed, 1 skipped) 
- DataObjectBase subclasses now correctly inherit the JSON-producing __repr__ method
- Value-based equality from dataclass-generated __eq__ is preserved and works appropriately
